title: The FCC wants to ban drones with LiDAR that it previously approved - Engadget
summary: Now, certain consumer DJI drones equipped with LiDAR sensing, like the DJI Air 3S, DJI Avata 360 and the DJI Mini 5 Pro could retroactively be pulled from the market.
